title: 3 How manie ſorts of Ceremonies there are.

segments.text: CEremonies are of two ſorts; ſome commaunded by God; ſome ordained by men. Thoſe that are commanded by god, cannot be changed but by God only; and thoſe are either ſacrifices or Sacraments: A ſacrifice is an obedience, which wee performe to God. A Sacrament is a token, whereby God teſtifieth ſomewhat to vs. Thoſe ceremonies which are ordained by mē, may be changed by the aduiſe of the church, if there bee good cauſes for the changing and alteration of them.
